title: Hottest toy for Christmas? Nvidia CEO plays with adorable Microduck robots, 20,000 sell
hook_text: Twenty thousand robots in one day
script:
Twenty thousand Microduck robots hit pre-order targets in just one day.
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang demonstrated the tiny robot on stage.
The robots stomp their feet while making tiny R2-D2 noises.
They sit down, play dead for a nap, and perform somersaults.
These movements activate immediately through simple voice commands.
The company behind this gadget is targeting the busy holiday gift market.
Would you want one of these on your desk?

editor.one_line: Misleading visuals and lack of specific product details make this unfit for publication.
script_fixes: LINE 1: Change to 'Microduck robots sold 20,000 units in their first day of pre-orders.'
LINE 6: Replace 'The company behind this gadget' with the actual manufacturer name.
LINE 7: Replace with a more engaging question, e.g., 'Would you pay for a desk-sized robot?'
visual_notes: line 1: Static text screen is boring; needs actual footage of the robot.
line 3: Using the TechCrunch logo instead of the actual robot is misleading.
line 4: The robot shown is a generic humanoid, not the Microduck described.
line 5: The visual shows a toy car/chassis, not the Microduck robot.
